description:
No. 23 Meadow Court is a beautifully presented and exceptionally spacious four/five-bedroom semi-detached home located in one of Newcastle West's most sought-after residential developments. Overlooking a large green area and occupying a generous site, this impressive property offers flexible accommodation, modern living spaces and excellent convenience, just a five-minute walk from the town centre via pedestrian access to Bóthar Buí.

A range of primary and secondary schools, childcare facilities, shops, cafés, restaurants and recreational amenities are all within easy reach, making this an ideal family home. The nearby Demesne and scenic riverside walks provide excellent outdoor recreation, while the N21 offers easy access to Limerick, Cork and Kerry. The popular seaside resort of Ballybunion, with its renowned beaches and golf courses, is also within comfortable driving distance.

The accommodation is designed with modern family living in mind. A welcoming entrance hall leads to a spacious living room, guest WC and a bright open-plan kitchen, dining area with sliding doors opening onto the garden & patio area creating a seamless indoor-outdoor flow. 

The kitchen is complemented by a fully fitted utility room with additional storage. Also on the ground floor is a versatile room suitable as a fifth bedroom, playroom or guest room. With direct access and a ramp, it also offers excellent accessibility as a downstairs bedroom.

Upstairs there are four generously proportioned bedrooms, including a master bedroom with ensuite, together with a stylish family bathroom. 

Outside, the property benefits from off-street parking , a timber shed, and a mature, landscaped rear garden offering exceptional privacy.

Combining generous accommodation, excellent functionality, a private landscaped site and a prime location close to schools, childcare facilities and the town centre, No. 23 Meadow Court presents a superb opportunity to acquire a quality family home in the heart of Newcastle West.
